name: Ikeri, Injuries Untold
summary: This apelike creature has the face of a bird. They are made of stone and carry an enormous mesa upon their back.
motive: Entangle, intimidate, peck stomp

features.name: Colossal Power
features.text: When Ikeri fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Swatting Pests
features.text: When Ikeri is attacked by a flying target within Far range, you can make a Peck (Head) or Punch (Arm) standard attack against the attacker. On a success, add a d20 to the damage roll and the target is knocked to the ground at the feet of the colossus.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When the Head is Destroyed, Ikeri is defeated.

features.name: Strike (Melee)
features.text: The Head is immune to damage from attacks not made within Melee range.

features.name: Follow-Up
features.text: When the Head succeeds on an attack against a target, it can immediately make an attack against another target it hasn’t attacked during this GM turn.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When the Torso is Destroyed, Ikeri is defeated.

features.name: Shake Off
features.text: Spend a Fear to throw off foes. All creatures on Ikeri must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail fall to the ground and must mark a HP. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Chain (A)
features.text: When all segments in Chain A are Destroyed, Ikeri is defeated.

features.name: Crush
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target on another segment of Ikeri. On a success, Ikeri grabs and crushes the target, dealing 1d20+4 physical damage and Restraining them until this Arm takes Major or greater damage. When this Arm takes the spotlight while the target is still in Ikeri’s hand, the target takes 1d20 physical damage.

features.name: Chain (A)
features.text: When all segments in Chain A are Destroyed, Ikeri is defeated.

features.name: Massive Stomp
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against a group.

name: Daktadae, the Cleaver
summary: A massive steel rhinoceros formed from a steam train, a cleaver emerging from his head instead of a horn.
motive: Clear forests, cleave, hew, stomp

features.name: Steam-Powered
features.text: Scalding fountains of steam erupt from Daktadae’s form. Spotlight any segment to make an attack with a +1 attack modifier against a target on that segment. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

features.name: Roll
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Daktadae drop to the ground and roll. All PCs on Daktadae or within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d20+5 physical damage; succeed or fail, the PCs are thrown off Daktadae onto the ground within Melee range of the colossus.

features.name: Slow Recovery
features.text: Clear a token from one Broken or Collapsed segment.

features.name: Colossal Power
features.text: When Daktadae fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Invulnerable
features.text: The Head can only take damage while it’s Broken.

features.name: Godcleaver
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 3d20+12 physical damage instead.

features.name: Head Toss
features.text: Mark a Stress and make a standard attack against all targets within range who are not on this segment or the Torso. On a success, place 2 tokens on this segment. It is Broken until all tokens are cleared.

features.name: Cleaver Recovery
features.text: After making a standard attack, place a token on this segment. It is Broken until all tokens are cleared.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When this segment is Destroyed, Daktadae is defeated.

features.name: Climbing (+3)
features.text: The Torso’s Difficulty gains a +3 bonus against action rolls made to climb it unless the Head is Broken.

features.name: Protected
features.text: The Torso is covered with external rib plates of unbreakable minerals. This segment can’t be damaged unless the Head is currently Broken or Destroyed.

features.name: Weak Point
features.text: The underbelly of the Torso has a weak point. When this segment marks HP from an attack within Melee range while the Head is Broken or Destroyed, it must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Massive Hoof
features.text: This segment’s standard attack is made with advantage and can target a group.

features.name: Shake The Earth
features.text: Daktadae rears up on their hind legs and slams down, creating a shockwave that knocks back all PCs within Very Close range that aren’t on Daktadae back to Close range and Rattles them until their next roll with Hope. While Rattled, the PC has disadvantage on reaction rolls.

features.name: Collapse
features.text: If one Foreleg is Destroyed, place a token on this segment. Until it is cleared, Daktadae is Collapsed, allowing PCs to climb directly onto the Torso and Head. If both Forelegs are Destroyed, Daktadae is Collapsed permanently.

features.name: Massive Hoof
features.text: This segment’s standard attack is made with advantage and can target a group.

features.name: Backward Kick
features.text: All targets within Very Close range behind Daktadae must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8+10 physical damage.

features.name: Collapse
features.text: If one Hindleg is Destroyed, place a token on this segment. Until it is cleared, Daktadae is Collapsed, allowing PCs to climb directly onto the Torso and Head. If both Hindlegs are Destroyed, Daktadae is Collapsed permanently.

name: Poy, Sky Skimmer of the Dust Sea
summary: This massive shoebill stork is formed from the dust of the Drylands and traps enemies in their cavernous beak.
motive: Corral, intimidate, maintain distance

features.name: Flying
features.text: Poy can fly unless one of their Wings is Destroyed. While Poy is flying, each segment’s Difficulty gains a +2 bonus against action rolls made by PCs who aren’t on Poy.

features.name: Strong Winds
features.text: While Poy is flying, no other flying creature can come within Close range of Poy without being blown backward by their powerful wings.

features.name: Fall Off
features.text: When a PC falls off Poy while the colossus is flying, they take 3d20+6 physical damage if they hit the ground.

features.name: Colossal Power
features.text: When Poy fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Bill Trap
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target on Poy. On a success, the target takes 3d6+6 physical damage and is Trapped inside Poy’s bill until the Head takes Major or greater damage. Poy’s damage thresholds are doubled against damage dealt by Trapped targets.

features.name: Cascade
features.text: When this segment is Destroyed, the Neck must mark 3 HP.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When this segment is Destroyed, Poy is defeated.

features.name: Protected
features.text: Poy’s Neck is protected by swirling magic. The Neck only marks HP from the “Cascade” feature.

features.name: Invulnerable
features.text: This segment is immune to all damage.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.text: When this segment is successfully attacked, Poy dive-bombs the attacker and all targets within Very Close range of them. The targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+9 physical damage. Targets who succeed can mark a Stress to climb onto one of Poy’s Talons.

features.name: Dust Storm
features.text: Poy bats their wings, filling the air and making it much harder to see. Any attacks made by PCs beyond Melee range have disadvantage until the next GM turn.

features.name: Flap
features.text: Poy violently flaps a Wing. Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets on the Wing. Targets Poy succeeds against take 3d8+4 physical damage and are knocked back onto the Tail. If the Tail is Destroyed, they instead fall off Poy.

features.name: Pick Up
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Melee range. If there’s an additional target within Very Close range of them, you can spotlight both Talons at once and make an attack against both targets instead. On a success, Poy picks up their targets, flies straight upwards, and drops them. If a target hits the ground, they take 5d20+4 physical damage.

features.name: Cascade
features.text: When this segment is Destroyed, the Neck must mark a HP.

features.name: Sweep
features.text: Poy’s tail curls up and sweeps across another segment. Spend a Fear to choose another segment and make an attack against all targets on that segment. Targets Poy succeeds against take 3d8+5 physical damage and are knocked back to an adjacent segment of your choice.

features.name: Cascade
features.text: When this segment is Destroyed, the Neck must mark 2 HP.

name: Kelir, the Virulent Hate & Her Hundred, Hundred Children
summary: A crablike, mountainous beast whose children scurry in and around her, bringing food as tribute.
motive: Consume, ravage, swarm

features.name: Brood Attack
features.text: Spotlight any segment to make an attack with a +6 attack modifier against a PC on that segment as Kelir’s hundred, hundred children swarm the target with their pincers. On a success, deal 4d8 physical damage.

features.name: Swatting Pests
features.text: When Kelir is attacked by a flying target within Far range, you can make a Pincer (Claws) standard attack against the attacker. On a success, add a d20 to the damage roll and the target is knocked to the ground within Far range.

features.name: Colossal Power
features.text: When Kelir fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: If this segment is Destroyed, Kelir is defeated.

features.name: Hateful Heart
features.text: Kelir’s heart is suspended within the body cavity, connected by thick veins and arteries. The Body Cavity is immune to damage unless her heart is the target of a successful attack. The heart can only be attacked from Far or greater range, or a PC must succeed on an Agility Roll while inside the Body Cavity to reach the heart to make an attack against it within Melee range.

features.name: Grab and Rend
features.text: Make an attack using Kelir’s “Brood Attack” action against a target in the Body Cavity. On a success, spend a Fear to deal double damage and Restrain the target until they’re freed with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Protective Swarm
features.text: Kelir’s Body Cavity is filled with her children, who protect her heart. A PC who makes an action roll in the Body Cavity must mark a Stress as they fight off Kelir’s children and their shearing pincers.

features.name: Strike (Very Close)
features.text: The Head is immune to damage from attacks not made within Very Close range.

features.name: Hateful Gaze
features.text: All targets within Far range that Kelir can see must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress as Kelir’s hate tries to consume their mind.

features.name: Armored
features.text: When the Shell marks HP from an attack, it marks 1 fewer HP.

features.name: Contagious Fury
features.text: All PCs in front of the Head within Far range replace their Hope Die with a d8 the next time they make an action roll as they struggle to keep Kelir’s hatred from consuming them.

features.name: Strike (Very Close)
features.text: The Claws are immune to damage from attacks not made within Very Close range.

features.name: Sever Hope
features.text: Make a standard attack against a PC. On a success, mark a Stress to cause the target to lose 1d4 Hope. Gain as many Fear as the Hope lost.

features.name: Grab & Hurl
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, instead of dealing damage, hurl the target within Far range in any direction. They must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or suffer 3d20 physical damage from the fall.

features.name: Climbing (−2)
features.text: An action roll made to climb on the leg gains a -2 penalty to its Difficulty.

features.name: Destructive Scuttle
features.text: Mark a Stress to move up to Far range in any direction. All creatures in that path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Kelir can’t use this action if she is Collapsed.

features.name: Full Collapse
features.text: Once three Legs are Destroyed, Kelir Collapses and PCs can climb on the Shell and Head from the ground.

name: Acid Burrower
summary: A horse-sized insect with digging claws and acidic blood.
motive: Burrow, drag away, feed, reposition

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Burrower can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Earth Eruption
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Burrower burst out of the ground. All creatures within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Spit Acid
features.text: Make an attack against all targets in front of the Burrower within Close range. Targets the Burrower succeeds against take 2d6 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Acid Bath
features.text: When the Burrower takes Severe damage, all creatures within Close range are bathed in their acidic blood, taking 1d10 physical damage. This splash covers the ground within Very Close range with blood, and all creatures other than the Burrower who move through it take 1d6 physical damage.

name: Adult Flickerfly
summary: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.
motive: Collect shiny things, hunt, nest, swoop

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Never Misses
features.text: When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target's Evasion is halved against the attack.

features.name: Deadly Flight
features.text: While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.text: Spend a Fear to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take 3d8 direct physical damage.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or become overwhelmed by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take 3d8+3 direct magic damage.

features.name: Uncanny Reflexes
features.text: When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to take half damage.

name: Ahuizotl
summary: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.
motive: Ambush, drown, restrain

features.name: Aquatic Attacker
features.text: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Tail Swat
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

features.name: Drag and Bag
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily Restrain them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets Restrained in this way.

name: Apprentice Assassin
summary: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.
motive: Act reckless, kill, prove their worth, show off

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Arch-Necromancer
summary: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.
motive: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect

features.name: Dance of Death
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.text: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Not Today, My Dears
features.text: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: Your Life is Mine
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

name: Archer Guard
summary: A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the settlement's colors.
motive: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Hobbling Shot
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have disadvantage on Agility Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.

name: Archer Squadron
summary: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.
motive: Stick together, survive, volley fire

features.name: Horde (1d6+3)
features.text: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d6+3 physical damage instead.

features.name: Focused Volley
features.text: Spend a Fear to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take 1d10+4 physical damage.

features.name: Suppressing Fire
features.text: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d6+3 physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

name: Archmage
summary: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.
motive: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Orbiting Aegis
features.text: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

features.name: Force Salvo
features.text: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

features.name: Fireball
features.text: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

features.name: Counterspell
features.text: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

name: Assassin Poisoner
summary: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.
motive: Anticipate, get paid, kill, taint food and water

features.name: Grindeloth Venom
features.text: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Out of Nowhere
features.text: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

features.name: Fumigation
features.text: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

name: Atototl
summary: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.
motive: Avoid, escape, misdirect

features.name: Wind Lord
features.text: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

features.name: Stone of Omens
features.text: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

features.name: Archer's Bane
features.text: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

name: Banshee
summary: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.
motive: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.text: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

name: Basilisk
summary: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.
motive: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait

features.name: Petrify
features.text: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already Stiff, they become Petrified. While Stiff, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

features.name: CRONCH!
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

name: Battle Box
summary: A cube-shaped construct with a different rune on each of their six sides.
motive: Change tactics, trample foes, wait in disguise

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Randomized Tactics
features.text: Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The Box uses the corresponding move:Mana Beam: The Box fires a searing beam. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 magic damage.Fire Jets: The Box shoots into the air, spinning and releasing jets of flame. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 2d8 physical damage.Trample: The Box rockets around erratically. Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 1d6+5 physical damage and are Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.Shocking Gas: The Box sprays out a silver gas sparking with lightning. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress.Stunning Clap: The Box leaps and their sides clap, creating a concussive boom. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until the cube is defeated.Psionic Whine: The Box releases a cluster of mechanical bees whose buzz rattles mortal minds. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 2d4+9 direct magic damage.

features.name: Overcharge
features.text: Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can mark a Stress to add a d6 to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Death Quake
features.text: When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 2d8+1 magic damage.

name: Bear
summary: A large bear with thick fur and powerful claws.
motive: Climb, defend territory, pummel, track

features.name: Overwhelming Force
features.text: Targets who mark HP from the Bear's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Bite
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage and the target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Bear makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Berserker Alpha
summary: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.
motive: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

features.name: Pack Fury
features.text: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.text: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Berserker Initiate
summary: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.
motive: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

features.name: Pack Fury
features.text: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.text: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Bladed Guard
summary: An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the settlement's colors.
motive: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Shield Wall
features.text: A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the Guard must succeed on an Agility Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within Melee range of another guard in the line, the Difficulty increases by the total number of guards in the line.

features.name: Detain
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they break free with a successful attack, Finesse Roll, or Strength Roll.

name: Brawny Zombie
summary: A large corpse, decay-bloated and angry.
motive: Crush, destroy, hurl debris, slam

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Rend Asunder
features.text: Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has Restrained. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Rip and Tear
features.text: When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

name: Bugboar
summary: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.
motive: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

features.name: Surprise!
features.text: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d8 damage.

features.name: Brutal
features.text: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to deal an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Warheart
features.text: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can spend a Fear to negate it.

name: Catrin
summary: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.
motive: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything

features.name: Attracted to Wealth
features.text: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

features.name: The Weight of Opulence
features.text: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

features.name: Expensive Failure
features.text: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

name: Cave Ogre
summary: A massive humanoid who sees all sapient life as food.
motive: Bite off heads, feast, rip limbs, stomp, throw enemies

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Ogre. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Bone Breaker
features.text: The Ogre's attacks deal direct damage.

features.name: Hail of Boulders
features.text: Mark a Stress to pick up heavy objects and throw them at all targets in front of the Ogre within Far range. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Ogre succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rampaging Fury
features.text: When the Ogre marks 2 or more HP, they can rampage. Move the Ogre to a point within Close range and deal 2d6+3 direct physical damage to all targets in their path.

name: Centaur Warden
summary: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motive: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19 – 20.

features.name: Trample
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Quick Volley
features.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

name: Cephilith Abomination
summary: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.
motive: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab

features.name: Toxic Skin
features.text: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

features.name: Bear Hug
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

features.name: Crunch!
features.text: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

features.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
features.text: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

name: Cephilith Hatchling
summary: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.
motive: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Comatize
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Cephilith Novitiate
summary: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.
motive: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Sacrifice Self
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

name: Cephilith Priest
summary: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.
motive: Break the unbelievers' minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan's arrival, sing its praises

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Cerebral Incursion
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target's ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

features.name: Telekinetic Grasp
features.text: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

name: Cephilith Titan
summary: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.
motive: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you you can spend a Fear.

features.name: Merely a Projection
features.text: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating its true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Psychic Scream
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Summon Worshippers
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

name: Chaos Skull
summary: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.
motive: Cackle, consume magic, serve creator

features.name: Levitation
features.text: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can't be Restrained.

features.name: Wards
features.text: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Magic Burst
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

features.name: Siphon Magic
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

name: Chicken-Foot Hut
summary: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.
motive: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

features.name: Fast
features.text: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

name: Chimera
summary: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.
motive: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle

features.name: Rending Jaws
features.text: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

features.name: Double Claw
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Breath of Fire
features.text: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

features.name: Serpent Strike
features.text: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

name: Cipactli
summary: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.
motive: Consume, reshape the land, trample

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Many Mouths
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Frenzied Feeding
features.text: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

features.name: Quaking Footfalls
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lifeblooded
features.text: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Verdant Explosion
features.text: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

name: Cloud Titan
summary: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.
motive: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

features.name: Mist Weaver
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

features.name: Nebulous Transformation
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

features.name: Unleash the Menagerie
features.text: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

features.name: Wind Worker
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.text: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don't gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

name: Common Ruffian
summary: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.
motive: Do violence, seek security and survival

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1d8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.text: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

name: Conscript
summary: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.
motive: Follow orders, gang up, survive

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Construct
summary: A roughly humanoid being of stone and steel, assembled and animated by magic.
motive: Destroy environment, serve creator, smash target, trample groups

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Construct can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Weak Structure
features.text: When the Construct marks HP from physical damage, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Trample
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in the Construct's path when they move. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d8 physical damage.

features.name: Overload
features.text: Before rolling damage for the Construct's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the spotlight again.

features.name: Death Quake
features.text: When the Construct marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d12+2 magic damage.

name: Courtesan
summary: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.
motive: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons

features.name: Searing Glance
features.text: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

name: Courtier
summary: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.
motive: Discredit, gain favor, maneuver, scheme

features.name: Mockery
features.text: Mark a Stress to say something mocking and force a target within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (14) to see if they can save face. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is Vulnerable until the scene ends.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.text: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Courtier convinces a crowd or prominent individual that the target is the cause of their current conflict or misfortune.

name: Crimson Lepus
summary: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.
motive: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: "Awww…"
features.text: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Evasive
features.text: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

features.name: "Run Away!"
features.text: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

name: Cryptimoth
summary: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.
motive: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Psychic Screech
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Shadow Swarm
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

features.name: Paranoia Glare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

name: Cult Adept
summary: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.
motive: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge

features.name: Enervating Blast
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Shroud of the Fallen
features.text: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

features.name: Shadow Shackles
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

features.name: Fear Is Fuel
features.text: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

name: Cult Fang
summary: A professional killer-turned-cultist.
motive: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks

features.name: Shadow's Embrace
features.text: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.text: Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

name: Cult Initiate
summary: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.
motive: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Cursed Merfolk
summary: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.
motive: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage

features.name: Fish-Tailed
features.text: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

features.name: Gang Up
features.text: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

features.name: "Get Over Here!"
features.text: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

name: Darkweave Crawler
summary: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.
motive: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Skin-Crawling
features.text: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Darkweave Venom
features.text: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

name: Darkweave Queen
summary: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.
motive: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Den Mother
features.text: Once per scene, spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Quicker Than She Looks
features.text: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

features.name: Darkfang Envenomation
features.text: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

name: Darkweave Spinner
summary: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.
motive: Bite, stick to the darkness

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.text: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings
summary: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.
motive: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

features.name: Horde (1d4)
features.text: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 physical damage instead.

features.name: "Get 'em Off , Get 'em Off !"
features.text: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a d6 when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

name: Deep Dweller
summary: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.
motive: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Brain Drain
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Call of the Deep
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Mucosal Contamination
features.text: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

name: Deeproot Defender
summary: A burly vegetable-person with grasping vines.
motive: Ambush, grab, protect, pummel

features.name: Ground Slam
features.text: Slam the ground, knocking all targets within Very Close range back to Far range. Each target knocked back by this must mark a Stress.

features.name: Grab and Drag
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to pull them into Melee range, deal 1d6+2 physical damage, and Restrain them until the Defender takes Severe damage.

name: Demon Lord Berzug
summary: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent's tail, a lizard's hind legs, a crab's claw arms, and a two-faced wolf's head.
motive: Destroy goodness, sow chaos, unseat rivals

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Chaos Lash
features.text: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Gaze into the Abyss
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result):1 – 2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.3 – 4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll.5 – 6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

features.name: Crushing Strike
features.text: When a PC marks HP from Berzug's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You you can spend a Fear.

features.name: Horrifying
features.text: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

name: Demon of Avarice
summary: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.
motive: Consume, fuel greed, sow dissent

features.name: Money Talks
features.text: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon's standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.

features.name: Numbers Must Go Up
features.text: Add a bonus to the Demon's attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.

features.name: Money is Time
features.text: Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear) to spotlight 1d4+1 allies.

name: Demon of Despair
summary: A cloaked one-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.
motive: Make fear contagious, stick to the shadows, undermine resolve

features.name: Depths of Despair
features.text: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

features.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
features.text: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

features.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
features.text: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Demon of Hubris
summary: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.
motive: Condescend, declare premature victory, prove superiority

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.text: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

features.name: Unparalleled Skill
features.text: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon's standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

features.name: The Root of Villainy
features.text: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

features.name: You Pale in Comparison
features.text: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

name: Demon of Jealousy
summary: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.
motive: Join in on others' success, take what belongs to others, hold grudges

features.name: Unprotected Mind
features.text: The Demon's standard attack deals direct damage.

features.name: My Turn
features.text: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Rivalry
features.text: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

features.name: What's Yours Is Mine
features.text: When a PC takes severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or of their choice from the target's inventory.

name: Demon of Wrath
summary: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.
motive: Fuel anger, impress rivals, wreak havoc

features.name: Anger Unrelenting
features.text: The Demon's attacks deal direct damage.

features.name: Battle Lust
features.text: Spend a Fear to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.

features.name: Retaliation
features.text: When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

features.name: Blood and Souls
features.text: Countdown (Loop 6). Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon 1d4 Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

name: Demonic Hound Pack
summary: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.
motive: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Dreadhowl
features.text: Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Dire Bat
summary: A winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.
motive: Dive-bomb, hide, protect leader

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Screech
features.text: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Guardian
features.text: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

name: Dire Pangolati
summary: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.
motive: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

features.name: Armor Eater
features.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals 2d6+10 physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.text: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

name: Dire Wolf
summary: A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.
motive: Defend territory, harry, protect pack, surround, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hobbling Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 direct physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.

name: Doppelhound
summary: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.
motive: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive

features.name: Blink Beast
features.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

name: Dragon Knight
summary: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.
motive: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above

features.name: High Ground
features.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

name: Dragon Mother Mitera
summary: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.
motive: Birth destruction, control the battlefield, fly, repel invaders, use all available options

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Diamond Hide
features.text: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. It ticks down from Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Elemental Breath
features.text: Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice:Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP.Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target.Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP.Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rollsuntil they mark Stress to clear the condition.Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it.Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rollsthat rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature.Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.text: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

features.name: Fearsome
features.text: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Seven-Headed
features.text: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the "Elemental Breath" option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see "Diamond Hide").

name: Drake
summary: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.
motive: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Guard Dog
features.text: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

name: Dryad
summary: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.
motive: Camouflage, drive out, preserve the forest

features.name: Bramble Patch
features.text: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or take more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

features.name: Grow Saplings
features.text: Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: We Are All One
features.text: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally's life force is returned to the forest.

name: Dullahan
summary: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.
motive: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Spectral Mount
features.text: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

features.name: Bone Whip Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Death Glare
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

name: Electric Eels
summary: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.
motive: Avoid larger predators, shock prey, tear apart

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Paralyzing Shock
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

name: Elemental Spark
summary: A blazing mote of elemental fire.
motive: Blast, consume, gain mass

features.name: Minion (9)
features.text: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Elephant
summary: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.
motive: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize

features.name: Trample
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

name: Elite Soldier
summary: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.
motive: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances

features.name: Reinforce
features.text: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

features.name: Vassal's Loyalty
features.text: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

name: Elk
summary: A large deer.
motive: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

features.name: Headbutt
features.text: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals 1d12+2 physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.text: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

name: Entombed Cat Beast
summary: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.
motive: Rush attack, shred, terrify

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.text: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
