features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and you can spend a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

name: Entombed Elite Guard
summary: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.
motive: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one

features.name: Battle Formation
features.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

name: Entombed Empress
summary: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.
motive: Command inferiors, curse the invaders

features.name: Empty Husk
features.text: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.text: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.text: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

name: Entombed Necropriest
summary: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.
motive: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon

features.name: Invigorate
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and Restrain them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target Restrained in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

name: Entombed Skin Beetles
summary: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.
motive: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Omophagous
features.text: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

name: Entombed Stonemason
summary: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.
motive: stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

name: Failed Experiment
summary: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.
motive: Devour, hunt, track

features.name: Warped Fortitude
features.text: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.

features.name: Lurching Lunge
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.

name: Falcon
summary: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.
motive: Circle, clutch, dive, spy

features.name: Nimble Flyer
features.text: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

features.name: Dive Bomb
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Fallen Shock Troop
summary: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.
motive: Crush, dominate, earn relief, punish

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura of Doom
features.text: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Fallen Sorcerer
summary: Warped mage bound by the bargains they made in life.
motive: Acquire, dishearten, dominate, torment

features.name: Conflagration
features.text: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.text: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.text: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Shackles of Guilt
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

name: Fallen Warlord: Realm-Breaker
summary: A fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.
motive: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage
features.text: Countdown(Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion
summary: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.
motive: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement
features.text: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

name: Fellmounted Shadow King
summary: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.
motive: Find magic items, inspire fear, patrol skies

features.name: Fellmount
features.text: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he's knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Light and Shadow
features.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

features.name: Relic Hunter
features.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

features.name: Hellsong
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King's mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can't lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

features.name: Air Support
features.text: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

name: Fire Titan
summary: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.
motive: Act valorously, make war, think tactically

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Masterwork Armor
features.text: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hurl Rock
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

features.name: Skull Splitter
features.text: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

features.name: Blazing Heart
features.text: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

name: Fire Titan Warlord
summary: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.
motive: Compete against rivals, conquer the weak, craft colossal war machines

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Colossus Crafter
features.text: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Release the Hounds
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Spinning Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and you can spend a Fear.

features.name: Ground-Breaking
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

name: Flock of Feather Fiends
summary: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.
motive: incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes

features.name: Horde (1d6+1)
features.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

name: Fowlbear
summary: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.
motive: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become Vulnerable until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

name: Frost Titan
summary: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.
motive: Claim trophies, raid and pillage, test mettle

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: War Horn
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.text: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

features.name: Cleaving Strike
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Trophy Hunter
features.text: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

name: Fungispunj Sporeling
summary: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.
motive: Avoid violence, spray attackers

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.text: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

name: Fungispunj Sporophore
summary: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.
motive: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.text: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.text: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle
summary: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.
motive: Acquire riches, capsize trading vessels, lie in wait, use the waves as cover

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Piercing Bite
features.text: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

features.name: Tail Bash
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

features.name: Gigaton Splash
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Steam Breath
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

name: Gargantuan War Machine
summary: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.
motive: Crush, destroy

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Awesome Size
features.text: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark Stress.

features.name: Rocket Punch
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

features.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Supercharged
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine's chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

name: Gargoyle
summary: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.
motive: Hide in plain sight, overwatch, swoop down

features.name: Unliving
features.text: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Swooping Strike
features.text: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

features.name: Petrifying Slash
features.text: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable. If the target is already Vulnerable, they become Restrained. If the target is already Vulnerable and Restrained, they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

name: Ghastly Legion
summary: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.
motive: Overwhelm, serve, swarm

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

features.name: Necroplasmic
features.text: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

features.name: Final Act
features.text: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

name: Giant Beastmaster
summary: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.
motive: Command, make a living, maneuver, pin down, protect companion animals

features.name: Two as One
features.text: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

features.name: Pinning Strike
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can mark a Stress to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.

features.name: Deadly Companion
features.text: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster's control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

name: Giant Brawler
summary: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.
motive: Make a living, overwhelm, slam, topple

features.name: Battering Ram
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.text: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Giant Eagle
summary: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.
motive: Hunt prey, stay mobile, strike decisively

features.name: Flight
features.text: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Take Off
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle's massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts them to the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.text: While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn't prevented during the PCs' next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

name: Giant Mosquitoes
summary: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.
motive: Fly away, harass, steal blood

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodseeker
features.text: When the Mosquitoes' attack causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to force the target to mark an additional HP.

name: Giant Octopus
summary: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motive: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.text: When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.text: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.text: Mark a Stress to deal 3d8 direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

name: Giant Rat
summary: A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival.
motive: Burrow, hunger, scavenge, wear down

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Rats within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Giant Recruit
summary: A giant fighter undergoing borrowed armor.
motive: Batter, make a living, overwhelm, terrify

features.name: Minion (7)
features.text: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Giant Scorpion
summary: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.
motive: Ambush, feed, grapple, poison

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

features.name: Venomous Stinger
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to deal 1d4+4 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Glass Snake
summary: A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard trail wherever they go.
motive: Climb, feed, keep distance, scare

features.name: Armor-Shredding Shards
features.text: After a successful attack against the Snake within Melee range, the attacker must mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an HP.

features.name: Spinning Serpent
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Snake succeeds against take 1d6+1 physical damage.

features.name: Spitter
features.text: Spend a Fear to introduce a 6 Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the spotlight, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within Far range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d4 physical damage. The Snake can take the spotlight a second time this GM turn.

name: Gobstalker
summary: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
features.text: The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or spend a Fear to choose instead:Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the targetWhile Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition.Corrode. The target takes 2d8 magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage.Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount.Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16).Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming Vulnerable and Restrained until they mark 2 Stress.Sear. The target takes 2d8 direct magic damage.Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16).Slow. The target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.text: On a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

name: Gorgon
summary: A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that their peace has been disturbed.
motive: Corner, hit-and-run, petrify, seek vengeance

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Suneater Arrows
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target Glows until the end of the scene and can't become Hidden. Attack rolls made against a Glowing target have advantage.

features.name: Crown of Serpents
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range using the Gorgon's protective snakes. On a success, mark Stress to deal 2d10+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.text: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a HP and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This countdown ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a death move. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification countdowns end.

features.name: Death Glare
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Greater Earth Elemental
summary: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.
motive: Avalanche, knock over, pummel

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Crushing Blows
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.text: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

features.name: Rockslide
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries all the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 2d12+5 physical damage and become Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Greater Water Elemental
summary: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.
motive: Deluge, disperse, drown

features.name: Water Jet
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+7 physical damage and the target's next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Drowning Embrace
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

features.name: High Tide
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to knock the target back to Close range.

name: Green Ooze
summary: A moving mound of translucent green slime.
motive: Camouflage, consume and multiply, creep up, envelop

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. The target must mark an additional Stress when they make an action roll. If the Ooze takes Severe damage, the target is freed.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: Griffin
summary: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.
motive: Hunt, look for an opening, swoop

features.name: Treasure Hoarder
features.text: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin's attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

features.name: Swooping Slash
features.text: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

name: Grimmling Warband
summary: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.
motive: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Cowardly
features.text: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

name: Guahalan Alebrujo
summary: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.
motive: Destroy, give no quarter, ravage

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.text: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can mark a Stress to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.text: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

name: Guahalan Fang Lord
summary: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.
motive: Bolster allies, lead the pack, rally the troops

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.text: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

name: Guahalan Shifter
summary: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.
motive: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
summary: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.
motive: Protect, sacrifice, surround

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.text: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.text: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
summary: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.
motive: Abjure, bolster, summon

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer summon 2d4 Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.text: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can spend a Fear to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

name: Hallowed Archer
summary: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.
motive: Focus fire, obey, retribution, volley

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.text: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

name: Hallowed Choir
summary: A heavenly host of winged humanoids whose song calls forth tears of religious awe.
motive: Drown out disbelief, raise voices

features.name: Horde (2d10)
features.text: When the Choir has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d10 magic damage instead.

features.name: Celestial Coda
features.text: Countdown (Loop 3). The Choir's divine song builds on itself with each refrain. When the Choir first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC gains a Hope. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block. The Choir gains a bonus to its damage rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block.

features.name: Aural Assault
features.text: The Choir unleashes its built-up divine energy in a single burst, clearing all tokens from this stat block. Deal 1d12 direct magic damage to each enemy within Close range for each token cleared.

name: Hallowed Soldier
summary: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.
motive: Obey, outmaneuver, punish, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Harbinger of Death
summary: A desiccated corpse riding atop a skeletal horse. Their eyes are sewn shut and their body is wrapped in a burial shroud of dust and ash.
motive: Bring judgment, cut them down, move swiftly, seek relentlessly, take souls

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Fear the Reaper
features.text: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Decapitate
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a death move.

features.name: Wake the Fallen
features.text: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.text: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

name: Harbinger of Famine
summary: A dried-out husk of a body riding atop a withered white horse. They are covered in mouths and surrounded by swarming flies.
motive: Drain, impoverish, weaken, wither

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Hunger Pangs
features.text: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can't spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Drain Essence
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

features.name: Too Many Mouths
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Withering Touch
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

name: Harbinger of Pestilence
summary: A bloated and rotting agglomeration of wriggling insects and slugs formed into a single humanoid mass riding a worm-eaten horse.
motive: Corrupt the pure, infect the weak, summon plague and disease

features.name: Halo of Contagion
features.text: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rollsuntil they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaffected by the condition.

features.name: Mount
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Locust Swarm
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1 – 2, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Frog Spawn
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1 – 3, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Plague Bringer
features.text: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them.

name: Harbinger of War
summary: A warrior clad in black armor and a horned helmet and bearing a bloody banner.
motive: Destroy utterly, fight honorably, relish combat, shield-bash, strike powerfully

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Iron Dice
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

features.name: Supreme Commander
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.text: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

name: Harpy
summary: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.
motive: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

features.name: Toxic Aura
features.text: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Swooping Attack
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals 3d6 physical damage.

name: Harrier
summary: A nimble fighter armed with javelins.
motive: Flank, harry, kite, profit

features.name: Maintain Distance
features.text: After making a standard attack, the Harrier can move anywhere within Far range.

features.name: Fall Back
features.text: When a creature moves into Melee range to make an attack, you can mark a Stress before the attack roll to move anywhere within Close range and make an attack against that creature. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

name: Head Guard
summary: A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice.
motive: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

features.name: Rally Guards
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight the Head Guard and up to 2d4 allies within Far range.

features.name: On My Signal
features.text: Countdown (5). When the Head Guard is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within Far range make a standard attack with advantage against the nearest target within their range. If any attacks succeed on the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Head Vampire
summary: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
motive: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Look Into My Eyes
features.text: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

features.name: Feed on Followers
features.text: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: The Hunt Is On
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Lifesuck
features.text: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

name: High Seraph
summary: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.
motive: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Seraph is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.text: Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: Hill Titan
summary: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.
motive: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.text: PCs have advantage on action rollsto trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.text: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

name: Hive Walker
summary: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.
motive: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive

features.name: Blood Honey
features.text: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.text: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

name: Huge Green Ooze
summary: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.
motive: Camouflage, creep up, envelop, multiply

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: Hydra
summary: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.
motive: Devour, regenerate, terrify

features.name: Many-Headed Menace
features.text: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Terrifying Chorus
features.text: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Magical Weakness
features.text: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
summary: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.
motive: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'-Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

name: Jagged Knife Bandit
summary: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.
motive: Escape, profit, steal, throw smoke

features.name: Climber
features.text: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

features.name: From Above
features.text: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 1d10+1 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

name: Jagged Knife Hexer
summary: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.
motive: Command, hex, profit

features.name: Curse
features.text: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily Curse them. While the target is Cursed, you can mark a Stress so that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

features.name: Chaotic Flux
features.text: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+3 magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

name: Jagged Knife Kneebreaker
summary: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.
motive: Grapple, intimidate, profit, steal

features.name: I've Got 'Em
features.text: Creatures Restrained by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

features.name: Hold Them Down
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is Restrained and Vulnerable. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

name: Jagged Knife Lackey
summary: A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves.
motive: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Jagged Knife Lieutenant
summary: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.
motive: Bully, command, profit, reinforce

features.name: Tactician
features.text: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, mark a Stress to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

features.name: More Where That Came From
features.text: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

features.name: Coup de Grace
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+12 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Jagged Knife Shadow
summary: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.
motive: Ambush, conceal, divide, profit

features.name: Backstab
features.text: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal 1d6+6 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Cloaked
features.text: Become Hidden until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.

name: Jagged Knife Sniper
summary: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.
motive: Ambush, hide, profit, reposition

features.name: Unseen Strike
features.text: If the Sniper is Hidden when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal 1d10+4 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

name: Juvenile Flickerfly
summary: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.
motive: Collect shiny things, hunt, swoop

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Peerless Accuracy
features.text: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

name: Kelpie
summary: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
motive: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

features.name: Captivating
features.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.

features.name: Heart's Desire
features.text: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Shapeshifter
features.text: Mark a Stress to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Enchant
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

name: Knight of the Realm
summary: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.
motive: Run down, seek glory, show dominance

features.name: Chevalier
features.text: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they're next spotlighted.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.text: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

features.name: Cavalry Charge
features.text: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: For the Realm!
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: Kraken
summary: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.
motive: Consume, crush, drown, grapple

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.text: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.text: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Lamia
summary: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
motive: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

features.name: Constriction
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.text: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.text: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

name: Lamplight Beguiler
summary: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
motive: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

features.name: Doppel-Dangler
features.text: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

features.name: Entice
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

features.name: Gulp
features.text: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

name: Landshark
summary: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.
motive: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey

features.name: Burrowing
features.text: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.text: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.text: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Landshark Behemoth
summary: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.
motive: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.text: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.text: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.text: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

name: Manticore
summary: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.
motive: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.text: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.text: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.text: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

name: Masked Thief
summary: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.
motive: Evade, hide, pilfer, profit

features.name: Quick Hands
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or from the target's inventory.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: Mark a Stress to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

name: Masque Muerte
summary: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.
motive: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

features.name: Libre
features.text: The Masque Muerte can't be Restrained.

features.name: Heel Turn
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

features.name: Spectral Suplex
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

features.name: Unmasking Death
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Tag Team
features.text: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

name: Master Assassin
summary: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.
motive: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios

features.name: Won't See It Coming
features.text: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're Hidden.

features.name: Strike as One
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

features.name: The Subtle Blade
features.text: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Mechanorb
summary: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.
motive: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

features.name: Hive Mind
features.text: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics
features.text: Pool. When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

name: Merchant
summary: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.
