motive: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit

features.name: Preferential Treatment
features.text: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.

features.name: The Runaround
features.text: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.

name: Merchant Baron
summary: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.
motive: Abusive power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: Everyone Has a Price
features.text: Spend a Fear to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

features.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4+1 Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron's will.

name: Minor Chaos Elemental
summary: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.
motive: Confound, destabilize, transmogrify

features.name: Arcane Master
features.text: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Sickening Flux
features.text: Mark a HP to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until their next rest or they clear a HP.

features.name: Remake Reality
features.text: Spend a Fear to transform the area within Very Close range into a different biome. All targets within this area take 2d6+3 direct magic damage.

features.name: Magical Reflection
features.text: When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half of the damage they dealt.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Minor Demon
summary: A crimson-hued creature from the Circles Below, consumed by rage against all mortals.
motive: Act erratically, corral targets, relish pain, torment

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Demon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: All Must Fall
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure with Fear while within Close range of the Demon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Hellfire
features.text: Spend a Fear to rain down hellfire within Far range. All targets within the area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d20+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Reaper
features.text: Before rolling damage for the Demon's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to the Demon's current number of marked HP.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Minor Fire Elemental
summary: A living flame the size of a large bonfire.
motive: Encircle enemies, grow in size, intimidate, start fires

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Elemental can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Scorched Earth
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. The ground within Very Close range of that point immediately bursts into flames. All creatures within this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8 magic damage from the flames. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Explosion
features.text: Spend a Fear to erupt in a fiery explosion. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against take 1d8 magic damage and are knocked back to Far range.

features.name: Consume Kindling
features.text: Three times per scene, when the Elemental moves on objects that are highly flammable, consume them to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Minor Treant
summary: An ambulatory sapling rising up to defend their forest.
motive: Crush, overwhelm, protect

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Treant is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Treant, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Minor Treants within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Minotaur Wrecker
summary: A massive bull-headed hybrid with a quick temper.
motive: Consume, gore, navigate, overpower, pursue

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Charging Bull
features.text: Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine their damage).

features.name: Gore
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.

name: Monarch
summary: The sovereign ruler of a nation, unearthed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.
motive: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy

features.name: Execute Them!
features.text: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Crossguard
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

features.name: Casus Bell
features.text: Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

name: Mortal Hunter
summary: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a cruelly cut demeanor.
motive: Devour, hunt, track

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.text: Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

name: Mountain Troll
summary: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.
motive: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Stolen Armor
features.text: Countdown. When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged Mountain Troll").

features.name: Flail Swipe
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

name: Night Children
summary: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
motive: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

features.name: Horde (2d6+2)
features.text: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swell Ranks
features.text: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: Oak Treant
summary: A sturdy animated old-growth tree.
motive: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches

features.name: Just a Tree
features.text: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Seed Barrage
features.text: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

features.name: Take Root
features.text: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

name: Octopus
summary: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motive: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape

features.name: Grapple
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Squirt Ink
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming Vulnerable until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

name: Oracle of Doom
summary: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.
motive: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.text: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.text: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d10+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.text: Once per day, spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.text: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.text: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

name: Outer Realms Abomination
summary: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.
motive: Confuse, demolish, devour, undermine

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.text: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.text: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.text: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Fungal Form
features.text: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

name: Outer Realms Corruptor
summary: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.
motive: Confuse, distract, overwhelm

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.text: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.text: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

name: Outer Realms Thrall
summary: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.
motive: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Owl Witch
summary: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.
motive: Consume essence, curse, predict death

features.name: Ill Omen
features.text: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

features.name: Witch Barrier
features.text: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Voice Mimicry
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

features.name: Nightmare Stare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Afflict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Afflicted, the target can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Afflicted creature.

features.name: Visions of a Violent End
features.text: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

name: Pain Priest
summary: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.
motive: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

features.name: Walk Between Worlds
features.text: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Pleasure and Pain
features.text: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

name: Panther
summary: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.
motive: Climb trees, pounce, stalk

features.name: Shadow Stalker
features.text: While Hidden, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

name: Patchwork Zombie Hulk
summary: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.
motive: Absorb corpses, flail, hunger, terrify

features.name: Destructive
features.text: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

features.name: Flailing Limbs
features.text: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

features.name: Another for the Pile
features.text: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Tormented Screams
features.text: Mark a Stress to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

name: Perfected Zombie
summary: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.
motive: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: On successful attack, all PCs in Far range lose Hope and you gain Fear.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.text: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack all targets within Very Close range; on success, targets are Vulnerable until next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to target within Very Close range of Zombie, spend a Fear to add Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

name: Petty Noble
summary: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.
motive: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: My Land, My Rules
features.text: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have disadvantage.

features.name: Guards, Seize Them!
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4 Bladed Guards, who appear at Far range to enforce the Noble's will.

features.name: Exile
features.text: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Noble proclaims that the target and their allies are exiled from the noble's territory. While exiled, the target and their allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

name: Phantom
summary: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.
motive: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

features.name: Incorporeal
features.text: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.text: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

features.name: Lingering Haunt
features.text: Countdown (1d6). When the Phantom is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

name: Phoenix
summary: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
motive: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

features.name: Purifying Aura
features.text: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Fireseed
features.text: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

name: Pirate Captain
summary: A charismatic sea dog with an impressive hat, eager to raid and plunder.
motive: Command, make 'em walk the plank, plunder, raid

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Captain marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reinforcements
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon a Pirate Raiders Horde, which appears at Far range.

features.name: No Quarter
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target who has three or more Pirates within Melee range of them. The Captain leads the Pirates in hurling threats and promises of a watery grave. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target marks 1d4+1 Stress. On a success, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Pirate Raiders
summary: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.
motive: Gang up, plunder, overwhelm

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

name: Pirate Tough
summary: A thickly muscled and tattooed pirate with melon-sized fists.
motive: Plunder, raid, smash, terrorize

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Tough marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Clear the Decks
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to move into Melee range of the target, dealing 3d4 physical damage and knocking the target back to Close range.

name: Plesiosaurus
summary: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
motive: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.text: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

name: Poltergeist
summary: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.
motive: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Possessor
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

features.name: Ghost Storm
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d12+2 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Rabble Mawb
summary: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.
motive: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Come Back Worse
features.text: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can spend a Fear to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

name: Ravenous Mockery
summary: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.
motive: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.text: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

name: Red Ooze
summary: A moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.
motive: Camouflage, consume and multiply, ignite, start fires

features.name: Creeping Fire
features.text: The Ooze can only move within Very Close range as their normal movement. They light any flammable object they touch on fire.

features.name: Ignite
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 1d8 magic damage and is ignited until they're extinguished with a successful Finesse Roll (14). While ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they make an action roll.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Red Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: Redcap Biters
summary: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.
motive: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.text: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ankle Weights
features.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

name: Redcap Breaker
summary: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motive: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

features.name: Backbreaker
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

features.name: Kneecapper
features.text: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

name: Redcap Butcher
summary: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.
motive: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble

features.name: Chop Happy
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Knife Thrower
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is Hidden, they make the attack with advantage.

name: Redcap Candlemaker
summary: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.
motive: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light

features.name: Hand of Glory
features.text: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is Hidden.

features.name: Torchbearer
features.text: The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

features.name: Dance in the Flames
features.text: Spend a token from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Redcap Skinner
summary: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motive: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shallow Cuts
features.text: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Roc
summary: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
motive: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.text: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.text: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

name: Rotted Zombie
summary: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.
motive: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Royal Advisor
summary: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.
motive: Curry favor, manufacture evidence, scheme

features.name: Devastating Retort
features.text: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

features.name: Bend Ears
features.text: Mark a Stress to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.text: Spend a Fear to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

name: Ruby Dragon
summary: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.
motive: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Fearsome
features.text: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Melting Breath
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Volcanic Fissure
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

features.name: Hot-Blooded
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

name: Rugaru
summary: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.
motive: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Child of Night
features.text: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodthirsty
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

features.name: Howl at the Moon
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Flesh Ripper
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.

name: Rust Eater
summary: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.
motive: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal

features.name: Stifling Pheromones
features.text: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Rust Touch
features.text: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

name: Sandwyrm
summary: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
motive: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.text: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast
summary: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.
motive: lamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline

features.name: Ka-Chomp
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 1d12 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Feeding Frenzy
features.text: When a creature marks HP, you can spend a Fear to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

features.name: Scaly
features.text: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

name: Scarecrow
summary: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.
motive: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw

features.name: Made of Straw
features.text: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: Secret-Keeper
summary: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.
motive: Amass great power, plot, take command

features.name: Seize Your Moment
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Our Master's Will
features.text: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

features.name: Summoning Ritual
features.text: Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

features.name: Fallen Hounds
features.text: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

name: Sellsword
summary: An armed mercenary testing their luck.
motive: Charge, lacerate, overwhelm, profit

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Severed Shadow
summary: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.
motive: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shadow Grapple
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Shambling Zombie
summary: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.
motive: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh

features.name: Too Many to Handle
features.text: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

features.name: Horrifying
features.text: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend
summary: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.
motive: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonate
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.text: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.text: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die .

features.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed
summary: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.
motive: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Fiendish Resistance
features.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Demonic Rage
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Hall of Mirrors
features.text: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Flash Claw
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

features.name: Mind Games
features.text: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

name: Shark
summary: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.
motive: Find the blood, isolate prey, target the weak

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rending Bite
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Blood in the Water
features.text: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

name: Siren
summary: A half fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.
motive: Consume, lure prey, subdue with song

features.name: Captive Audience
features.text: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target Entranced by their song, the attack deals 2d10+1 damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Enchanting Song
features.text: Spend a Fear to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Entranced until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can mark a Stress to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While Entranced, a target can't act and is Vulnerable.

name: Skeleton Archer
summary: A fragile skeleton with a shortbow and arrows.
motive: Perforate distracted targets, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Opportunist
features.text: When two or more adversaries are within Very Close range of a creature, all damage they each deal to that creature is doubled.

features.name: Deadly Shot
features.text: Make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 3d4+8 physical damage.

name: Skeleton Dredge
summary: A clattering pile of bones.
motive: Fall apart, overwhelm, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Dredges within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Skeleton Knight
summary: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.
motive: Cut down the living, steal skin, wreak havoc

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Cut to the Bone
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take 1d8+2 physical damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Dig Two Graves
features.text: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d8+4 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.

name: Skeleton Warrior
summary: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.
motive: Feign death, gang up, steal skin

features.name: Only Bones
features.text: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Reform
features.text: When the Warrior is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

name: Soul-Shattered Mage
summary: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.
motive: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Broken Magic
features.text: Mark a Stress to roll a d6. The Mage uses the corresponding move:1 – 2: Dimension Rift. Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes 2d6 direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.3 – 4: Time Dilation. Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is Slowed until they roll with Hope. While Slowed, a target is Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they move.5 – 6: Discordant Visions. Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take 2d8 direct magic damage.

features.name: Feel My Pain
features.text: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

name: Spectral Archer
summary: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is Vulnerable.
motive: Move through solid objects, stay out of the fray, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Pick Your Target
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.

name: Spectral Captain
summary: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.
motive: Move through solid objects, rally troops, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Unending Battle
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

features.name: Hold Fast
features.text: When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Spectral Guardian
summary: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.
motive: Move through solid objects, protect treasure, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Grave Blade
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

name: Spellblade
summary: A mercenary combining swordplay and magic to deadly effect.
motive: Blast, command, endure

features.name: Arcane Steel
features.text: Damage dealt by the Spellblade's standard attack is considered both physical and magic.

features.name: Suppressing Blast
features.text: Mark a Stress and target a group within Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d8+2 magic damage. You gain a Fear for each target who marked HP from this attack.

features.name: Move as Unit
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight up to five allies within Far range.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Spellblade makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Spellbound Armor
summary: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.
motive: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently

features.name: Tireless
features.text: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

features.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
features.text: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

name: Sprite
summary: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motive: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness

features.name: Minion (2)
features.text: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Art of Invisibility
features.text: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

features.name: Dream Petal Poison
features.text: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

name: Spy
summary: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.
motive: Cut and run, disguise appearance, eavesdrop

features.name: Gathering Secrets
features.text: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

features.name: Fly on the Wall
features.text: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

name: Stag Knight
summary: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.
motive: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome

features.name: From Above
features.text: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Blade of the Forest
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target's Major threshold.

features.name: Thorny Armor
features.text: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

name: Stone Titan
summary: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.
motive: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Skillful Strike
features.text: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can mark a Stress and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Sunlight Sickness
features.text: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Hammer Smash
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Stonewraith
summary: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.
motive: Defend territory, isolate prey, stalk

features.name: Stonestrider
features.text: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are Hidden and immune to all damage.

features.name: Rocky Ambush
features.text: While Hidden, mark a Stress to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Avalanche Roar
features.text: Spend a Fear to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d10 physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Storm Titan
summary: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.
motive: Erupt violently, wait, watch

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.text: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix
summary: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.
motive: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Elemental Archon
features.text: Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect:Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam's path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage.Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated.Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets.Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape.

name: Swarm of Rats
summary: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.
motive: Consume, obscure, swarm

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: In Your Face
features.text: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

name: Sylvan Soldier
summary: A faerie warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.
motive: Ambush, hide, overwhelm, protect, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Forest Control
features.text: Spend a Fear to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage.

features.name: Blend In
features.text: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Hidden until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

name: Tangle Bramble
summary: An animate, blood-drinking tumbleweed.
motive: Consume, drain, entangle

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Bramble is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Tangle Bramble, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Tangle Brambles within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Drain and Multiply
features.text: When an attack from the Bramble causes a target to mark HP and there are three or more Tangle Bramble Minions within Close range, you can combine the Minions into a Tangle Bramble Swarm Horde. The Horde's HP is equal to the number of Minions combined.

name: Tangle Bramble Swarm
summary: A cluster of animated, blood-drinking tumbleweeds, each the size of a large gourd.
motive: Digest, entangle, immobilize

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Crush
features.text: Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+8 direct physical damage to a target with 3 or more bramble tokens.

features.name: Encumber
features.text: When the Swarm succeeds on an attack, give the target a bramble token. If a target has any bramble tokens, they are Restrained. If a target has 3 or more bramble tokens, they are also Vulnerable. All bramble tokens can be removed by succeeding on a Finesse Roll (12 + the number of bramble tokens) or dealing Major or greater damage to the Swarm. If bramble tokens are removed from a target using a Finesse Roll, a number of Tangle Bramble Minions spawn within Melee range equal to the number of tokens removed.

name: Temporal Enforcer
summary: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.
motive: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Time Looper
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

features.name: Move Between Moments
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

features.name: Instant Rewind
features.text: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

features.name: Invert Polarity
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can't be used to alter a critical success.

name: Tiny Green Ooze
summary: A small moving mound of translucent green slime.
motive: Camouflage, creep up

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

name: Tiny Red Ooze
summary: A small moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.
motive: Blaze, camouflage

features.name: Burning
features.text: When a creature within Melee range deals damage to the Ooze, they take 1d6 direct magic damage.

name: Treant Sapling
summary: A small, sentient tree sapling.
motive: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Triceratops
summary: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.
motive: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.text: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

name: Tyrannosaurus
summary: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.
motive: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.text: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.text: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

name: Unicorn
summary: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.
motive: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent

features.name: Celestial Lance
features.text: The Unicorn's standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.text: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally's HP.

features.name: Protective Aura
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

name: Urco
summary: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.
motive: Feed, frighten, hunt

features.name: Fearmonger
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Terror-Fueled
features.text: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Fear Eater
features.text: Spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of HP.

features.name: Baleful Gaze
features.text: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can spend a Fear to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a −1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

name: Valdenhax
summary: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.
motive: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers

features.name: To Me, My Pretties
features.text: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You you can spend a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

features.name: Shadow Strangler
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

features.name: Corpse Whisperer
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

features.name: Vexing Word
features.text: After a PC makes a roll, you can mark a Stress to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

name: Vampire
summary: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.
motive: Bite, charm, deceive, feed, intimidate

features.name: Draining Bite
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: Mistform
features.text: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

name: Vampire Bat Swarm
summary: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.
motive: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease

features.name: Horde (2d6)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.text: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsucker
features.text: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

name: Vampire Lord
summary: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.
motive: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Midnight Heart
features.text: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it's destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Unleash Hellfire
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Resurgence
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Melt into Shadow
features.text: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

name: Vault Guardian Gaoler
summary: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.
motive: Carry away, entrap, protect, pummel

features.name: Blocking Shield
features.text: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

features.name: Lock Up
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

name: Vault Guardian Sentinel
summary: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.
motive: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect

features.name: Kinetic Slam
features.text: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Box In
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.text: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 8d20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Vault Guardian Turret
summary: A massive hulking turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston-driven mechanical legs.
motive: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect

features.name: Slow Firing
features.text: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.text: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.text: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Viper
summary: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.
motive: Lie in wait, slither, strike

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous
features.text: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Viscera Sucker
summary: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.
motive: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Join or Die
features.text: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant
summary: A legendary, lava-hardened dragon. No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so.
motive: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cornered
features.text: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.text: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.text: Spend a Fear to smash the ground beneath an adversary within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
features.text: Countdown (1d12). Spend a Fear to activate it. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it reaches 0, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge
summary: Engaged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.
motive: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel invaders, respawn

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, target takes 4d8+14 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling area within Very Close range with lava. All targets must make Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. The area remains lava (6 HP damage on entry or action).

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll d10. On 8+, erupt lava in Very Close range: Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until clearing a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lava Splash
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from attack within Very Close, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals 2d10+4 direct physical damage to attacker.

features.name: Ashen Vengeance (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
summary: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.
