motive: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains +3 Difficulty.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.text: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.text: Mark a Stress to make attack against all targets within Close range. Success: 4d6+4 physical damage, knocked to Far range and Vulnerable until next roll with Hope.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.text: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical, mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

name: War Wizard
summary: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.
motive: Develop new spells, seek power, conquer

features.name: Battle Teleport
features.text: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.

features.name: Refresh Warding Sphere
features.text: Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard's Warding Sphere reaction.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't moved.

features.name: Arcane Artillery
features.text: Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Warding Sphere
features.text: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can't be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their Refresh Warding Sphere action.

name: Water Mother
summary: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.
motive: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water

features.name: Segmented
features.text: The Water Mother's body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

features.name: Eat the World
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

features.name: Constrict
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

features.name: Venom Surge
features.text: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

name: Waxwork Creation
summary: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.
motive: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: No Vital Organs
features.text: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

features.name: Wax Ball
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Splutch!
features.text: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Smothering Grapple
features.text: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation's wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

name: Weaponmaster
summary: A master-at-arms wielding a sword twice their size.
motive: Act first, aim for the weakest, intimidate

features.name: Goading Strike
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, mark a Stress to Taunt the target until their next successful attack. The next time the Taunted target attacks, they have disadvantage against targets other than the Weaponmaster.

features.name: Adrenaline Burst
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Weaponmaster makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Whisper Wraith
summary: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.
motive: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads

features.name: Greater Specter
features.text: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Spooky
features.text: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Nightmare Shroud
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisps
summary: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.
motive: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray

features.name: Horde (1d4−1)
features.text: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4−1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Kaleidoscopic
features.text: The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are Vulnerable.

features.name: Fascinating
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

name: Wyrmfiend
summary: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.
motive: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous Bite
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Wyrmlings
summary: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.
motive: Consume, shred, swarm

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ravenous
features.text: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

name: Wyvern
summary: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.
motive: a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.text: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Xero the Castle Killer
summary: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.
motive: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Collateral Damage
features.text: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Gigaton Stomp
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

features.name: Power Slide
features.text: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

features.name: Radioactive Breath
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

name: Young Dryad
summary: An imperious tree-person leading their forest's defenses.
motive: Command, nurture, prune the unwelcome

features.name: Voice of the Forest
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

features.name: Thorny Cage
features.text: Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they're freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Young Fire Dragon
summary: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.
motive: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.text: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

features.name: Flame Breath
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You you can spend a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Blazing Scales
features.text: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you you can spend a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

name: Young Ice Dragon
summary: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.
motive: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.text: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: No Hope
features.text: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whirlwind in an area within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Yufo
summary: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.
motive: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows

features.name: Telepathic
features.text: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

features.name: Psychic Strongbox
features.text: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

features.name: Glitch Wave
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

features.name: Temporal Corrosion
features.text: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

name: Zombie Legion
summary: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.
motive: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When Legion has half or more HP marked, standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.text: Legion has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When Legion takes Minor damage from attack within Melee, mark a Stress to make standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

name: Zombie Pack
summary: A group of shambling corpses instinctively moving together.
motive: Consume flesh, hunger, maul

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.text: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: Bartender
summary: The saloon's nexus of gossip and purveyor of "fine" spirits.
motive: Trade gossip, spread rumors, make the patrons drink

features.name: Rumor Mill
features.text: A PC can spend a number of handfuls of gold equal to 1 + the number of tokens on this stat block to add a rumor to an active investigation card. Then, add a token to this stat block. Clear this stat block at the end of the session.

features.name: You Drinkin' or What?
features.text: Spend a Fear to force a PC to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the PC must spend a handful of gold to buy a round for the house. If they can't, they must mark a Stress instead.

features.name: Get the Sheriff!
features.text: If violence breaks out in the saloon, you can spend a Fear to summon a Corrupt Sheriff and a Crooked Deputy, who immediately take the spotlight.

name: Black Hat Cattle Rustler
summary: A mounted outlaw known for stealing livestock.
motive: Lie in wait, strike when victims are at ease, get out if it's too hot

features.name: Stick 'em Up!
features.text: Spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Each target who fails marks a Stress and becomes temporarily Vulnerable.

features.name: Retreat!
features.text: When the Rustler marks one or more HP, they can mark a Stress to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with disadvantage.

name: Flim-Flam Mogul
summary: A greedy, exploitative business mogul from a far-off land who ruins the local economy for personal gain.
motive: Exploit everything, strip it all for parts, move on

features.name: Price of Privilege
features.text: A PC holding less than a bag of gold has disadvantage on all Presence Rolls against the Mogul.

features.name: Black Hat Bribe
features.text: Mark a Stress to introduce a number of Black Hat Cattle Rustlers equal to the number of PCs to the scene.

features.name: "Respectable" Business
features.text: Investigation (2). When the Mogul first appears and there isn't an unsolved investigation related to their unsavory business practices, create one with 2 related rumors.

features.name: Damning Exposé
features.text: If the PCs have successfully completed the Respectable Business Investigation when the Mogul appears, the Mogul cannot use Nepotism, Baby and becomes permanently Vulnerable.

features.name: Nepotism, Baby
features.text: If the Mogul is defeated before the party successfully completes the Respectable Business Investigation, start a Mogul Countdown (4) that ticks down every time the party long rests. When it triggers, a new Mogul replaces them.

name: Black Hat Desperado
summary: A vicious gang lieutenant who manipulates the downtrodden with promises of riches and redemption.
motive: Corral the crew, draw in foes, live to fight another day

features.name: Organized Chaos
features.text: All Black Hats within Very Close range of a Desperado gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

features.name: Right Where We Want 'em!
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d6+1 Black Hat Road Agents, who hop out from behind cover anywhere within Far range.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Desperado makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Open Fire!
features.text: When the Desperado takes Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to spotlight all Black Hat Road Agents within Very Close range of the attacker and have them make a shared attack roll against them. On a success, deal 2 damage for each Road Agent you spotlighted. Combine this damage.

name: Black Hat Road Agent
summary: A desperate farmer turned to banditry.
motive: Overwhelm and outnumber, blast 'em, stab 'em

features.name: Minion (7)
features.text: The Road Agent is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Road Agent, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Road Agents within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Black Hat Sapper
summary: A down-on-their-luck miner forced into banditry by union-busting mine moguls.
motive: Draw attention, corral foes, crush clustered enemies

features.name: Buckshot
features.text: When the Sapper's attack deals damage to a target, it also deals half damage to each creature within Melee range of the target.

features.name: Quarter Stick of Dynamite
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range. All creatures within Very Close range of that point take 2d8+4 physical damage.

features.name: Taking You With Me
features.text: When the Sapper would mark their last HP, they make a standard attack against the closest enemy within range, then mark their last HP.

features.name: Walk It Off
features.text: Once per scene, when the Sapper would mark a HP, they can mark 2 Stress instead.

name: Black Hat Sniper
summary: A former infantry sniper who can only find work plying their deadly trade to the highest bidder.
motive: Lie in wait, seek out vulnerabilities, pick off the weak

features.name: Camouflage Expert
features.text: The Sniper is Hidden while no PCs are within Close range.

features.name: Cull the Weak
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target at Close range or farther. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of HP the target has marked.

features.name: Piercing Round
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack that deals direct damage on a success.

name: Corrupt Sheriff
summary: A cruel and controlling sheriff with little to no scruples.
motive: Keep the toadies in line, let someone else handle it, call in the cavalry

features.name: There's An Arrangement
features.text: The Sheriff appears with a number of tokens on this stat block equal to the number of PCs in the scene.

features.name: Black Hat's Bargain
features.text: Spend any number of tokens to summon an equal number of Black Hat Road Agents within Very Far range as unassuming townsfolk don their bandit masks.

features.name: Lawbringer's Lasso
features.text: Spend a Fear to temporarily Restrain a target within Very Close range. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be pulled into Melee range.

features.name: Most Wanted
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to make a PC Most Wanted. A Most Wanted PC has disadvantage on Presence Rolls in civilized locations. A Most Wanted PC can clear the condition by spending a chest of gold to pay the bounty or by finding another way to clear their name.

features.name: Fearsome Reputation
features.text: When a PC rolls with Fear, place a token on this stat block.

features.name: It's Your Badge Now (Phase Change)
features.text: If a Crooked Deputy is within Very Close range when the Sheriff marks their last HP, spend a Fear to make the Crooked Deputy become a Corrupt Sheriff, retaining the same number of marked HP and Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Corrupt Sheriff makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Crooked Deputy
summary: A goon hastily deputized by the sheriff. Dense—both physically and mentally.
motive: Keep the sheriff safe, beat up criminals, get rich

features.name: Brutal Injustice
features.text: Restrained targets that take damage from the Deputy mark an additional HP.

features.name: Goon Squad
features.text: A Corrupt Sheriff gains a +1 bonus to their damage thresholds and attack rolls for every Deputy in the scene.

features.name: Rusty Revolver
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+6 damage. On a failure, mark a Stress.

features.name: I Ain't Seen Nothing
features.text: Once per scene, when the Deputy witnesses a PC break the law, you can spend a Fear to force the PC pay the Deputy a handful of gold. If they can't, the Deputy summons a Corrupt Sheriff within Very Far range. Immediately spotlight the Sheriff.

name: Emperor of Dirt
summary: A fearsome, charismatic, and Machiavellian outlaw who operates as a saloon owner ruling over a small frontier fiefdom.
motive: Maintain the status quo, keep operations nimble, deal with disruptions swiftly and forcefully

features.name: You'd Best Not Miss
features.text: Until the PCs successfully complete all "Vile Tasks" investigations, the Emperor is Untouchable.

features.name: Shell Game
features.text: Once per active investigation you can mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. Spend a token to give disadvantage to a PC investigating a rumor related to the Emperor.

features.name: Ain't Got Time For This
features.text: When a PC tries to harm the Emperor while he's Untouchable, he taunts the party, summons 4 Black Hat Road Agents, a Sniper, a Sapper, and a Desperado, and immediately escapes the scene. Alternatively, you can spend 12 Fear to force each PC to mark a scar and have them describe why their plan failed and how they ended up buried up to their necks in a sunbaked desert.

features.name: Vile Tasks
features.text: Investigations (3). When the Emperor is introduced, create an investigation with 2 rumors related to different illicit activities.

features.name: Can't Fight Change (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Emperor marks his last HP, replace him with the Emperor of Nothing with all HP and Stress cleared.

name: Emperor of Nothing
summary: Disgraced, exposed, and on the lam. This fallen outlaw is hard to catch and even harder to kill.
motive: Don't let them catch me, throw wave after wave of my own men at them, turn tail and run

features.name: Loyal to the Last
features.text: When the Emperor first appears, he's accompanied by 1 Black Hat Desperado, 7 Road Agents, 1 Sniper, and 1 Sapper. Despite the Emperor's fall, his Black Hat crew still believes in him.

features.name: Hail of Gunfire
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack roll against a target within Far range. On a success, roll 2d8 and a number of d6s equal to the number of Black Hats within Far range. The target takes physical damage equal to the total result.

features.name: Bloodlust of the Deposed
features.text: When a Black Hat within Close range deals Severe damage to a target, the Emperor immediately gains the spotlight.

features.name: No More Thrones
features.text: When the Emperor takes the spotlight with half or more of his HP marked, you can spend a Fear to have him make a dramatic exit. Start an Investigation (1) with 1 rumor to track him down. When investigation is completed, the Emperor loses the benefits of Loyal to the Last and becomes permanently Vulnerable.

name: Reclusive Gunsmith
summary: A broken down legendary gunsmith who gave up their trade out of regret for the violence their creations caused.
motive: Keep my talents hidden, stay on the run, refuse the unworthy

features.name: Wary of Strangers
features.text: A PC has disadvantage on Presence Rolls targeting the Gunsmith unless the Gunsmith has witnessed them succeed with Hope.

features.name: Gave Up the Trade
features.text: Anything but a critical success on a Presence roll to convince the Gunsmith to make a gun is considered a failure.

features.name: On the Move
features.text: Mark a Stress to remove a rumor from an active investigation related to the Gunsmith.

features.name: One Last Gun
features.text:
Gunsmith Countdown (3). If the PCs critically succeed on a roll to convince the gunsmith and ask them to make a gun they will begrudgingly agree. Start a countdown that ticks down every time the PCs complete a long rest. When the countdown triggers, the gun is ready and the PCs may return. When the PCs return for the gun they find the gunsmith holding it, having passed away in their sleep. The GM gains Fear equal to the number of PCs and the PCs may choose a primary firearm from the Pistolheart equipment tables and choose which trait it will use when making an attack. The gun has the following feature in addition to any it already has:
• Hex Bullets: This weapon ignores resistances.

features.name: Legend or Ghost?
features.text: Investigation (3). When the PCs first hear of the Gunsmith, create an investigation with 1 rumor about a legendary gunsmith who once crafted a gun that killed death itself.

name: Boneyard Bad Dog
summary: A very, very bad dog. Often caught burying its own bones.
motive: Terrify, encase enemies, let the bombers come

features.name: Frightening Speed
features.text: The Bad Dog can move up to Far range as part of an action.

features.name: Haunting Howl
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Bad Dog howl. Each PC within Far range who hears it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become Haunted until they roll with Hope. A Haunted PC can't clear Stress.

features.name: Bone Buries You
features.text: When the Bad Dog succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to make the target Restrained and Vulnerable until the Bad Dog takes Major or greater damage.

name: Boneyard Bomber
summary: Skittering, multi-limbed bone amalgamations, each with a payload of dynamite inside its ribcage.
motive: Creep, surround, create chain reactions

features.name: Minion (10)
features.text: The Bomber is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 10 damage a PC deals to the bomber, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Bombers within Very Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.text: Spend a Fear to start a Boom Countdown (3) that ticks down when a PC makes an action roll. When the countdown triggers, every Bomber in the scene is immediately defeated.

features.name: Volatile
features.text: When the Bomber is defeated, it explodes and deals 7 damage to every creature within Very Close range. A PC can mark a Stress to ignore this damage.

name: Boneyard Goldtooth
summary: A prospector whose greed followed them into undeath.
motive: Hit the rich one, steal gold, eat gold

features.name: Gold Eater
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack. On a success the target loses a handful of gold and the Goldtooth clears a HP or Stress.

features.name: Rusty Rifle
features.text: Make an attack roll against a creature within Far range. On a success, deal 3d6+6 damage. On a failure, mark a Stress.

features.name: Gold In Them Thar Bones!
features.text: When the Goldtooth marks their last HP, roll a d6. A number of handfuls of gold equal to the result erupts from the Goldtooth's bones.

name: Boneyard Skullripper
summary: A large skeleton, reinforced with bones that don't belong to it and holding a huge scattergun.
motive: Shrug off damage, keep foes in front, sacrifice the weak

features.name: Skull Collector
features.text: The Skullripper appears with 1d4 tokens on this stat block.

features.name: Bone Grinder
features.text: Spend a token from this stat block to make a standard attack with advantage against all PCs within Very Close range.

features.name: Reinforced Skeleton
features.text: When the Skullripper would take Minor damage, it marks a Stress instead.

features.name: Gimme Them Bones!
features.text: Spend a Fear to sacrifice a Goldtooth or Bad Dog within Melee range and clear either 2 HP or 2 Stress, then add a token to this stat block.

name: Catacomb Kid
summary: A notorious skeletal outlaw with a golden heart. Their avarice and commitment to chaos has earned them notoriety throughout the region.
motive: Keep it moving, hit 'em hard, make new friends

features.name: Buck the Law
features.text: The Kid can't be Restrained.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Kid can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: One for Each of You
features.text: Once per scene, you can mark a Stress to have the Kid reveal a second set of arms and pistols, giving them Relentless (4) until they take Severe damage.

features.name: Bone Beauty
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon a skeletal steed that erupts from the ground beneath the Kid. The Kid immediately mounts the steed and moves up to Far range in a line, making an attack roll against each creature they pass through and dealing 3d10+8 magic damage to each target they succeed against.

features.name: Frightening Precision
features.text: When the Kid misses an attack against a target, the target marks a Stress or gives the GM a Fear.

features.name: Heart of Gold
features.text: When the Kid would mark their last HP, they instead immediately clear all HP and attempt to befriend the PCs, impressed with their gunplay. If the PCs part on good terms with the Kid, the Kid gives one of them a Candy Skull. The next time the PC carrying the Candy Skull would make a death move they can break the Candy Skull instead. When they do so, they give the GM 3 Fear and work with them to narrate how the Kid swoops in at the last moment and saves the PC.

name: Frontier Marshal Paragon
summary: A paragon of law and order in pursuit of justice. Or vengeance. Or both.
motive: Pursue relentlessly, bring criminals to justice, don't be deterred by failure

features.name: Bulletproof
features.text: The Marshal is immune to physical damage from attacks made from beyond Very Close range.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Marshal can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Pistol Whip
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d10+8 physical damage.

features.name: Paragon's Lasso
features.text: Spend a Fear to temporarily Restrain a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or the Marshal pulls them into Melee range, then makes a Pistol Whip attack against them with advantage.

features.name: Justice... or Vengeance?
features.text: When the Marshal is defeated, they can choose to surrender. The PCs must choose whether they let the Marshal live or die. If the PCs let the Marshal live, start a long-term Justice Countdown (5) that ticks down when the party takes a long rest. When the Justice Countdown triggers, the Marshal reappears with a Marshal Posse to try and capture the PCs. If the PCs choose to kill the Marshal, start a long-term Vengeance Countdown (10) that ticks down when a PC kills a creature. When the Vengeance Countdown triggers, The Inexorable appears out of a howling desert storm and is immediately spotlighted.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Frontier Marshal makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Frontier Marshal Posse
summary: A group of mounted marshals hunting down a bounty.
motive: Encircle enemies, keep enemies pinned down, riddle enemies with bullets

features.name: Horde (3d4+2)
features.text: When the Posse has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Round 'Em Up!
features.text: Mark a Stress to introduce the Surrounded environment to the scene. This environment persists until the Posse has marked half or more of its HP.

features.name: Ring of Fire
features.text: Spend a Fear to force all PCs to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Each PC who fails takes 3d6+6 physical damage. If the Posse has marked half or more of their HP, reduce this damage to 3d4+2 instead.

features.name: Lone Survivor
features.text: When the Posse is defeated, the GM can spend 3 Fear to begin a long-term Lone Survivor Countdown (6). When the party rests, tick down the Survivor Countdown and narrate how a figure haunts the party from the horizon. When the countdown triggers, a Frontier Marshal Paragon confronts the party.

name: Dust Devil
summary: A thousand wailing spirits formed into a huge, fearsome twister filled with swirling shards of fulgurite and arcing necrolightning.
motive: Grow and enfold, ravage with lightning, protect the heart

features.name: Nightmare Storm
features.text: When encountered, the Dust Devil introduces the Surrounded environment (Difficulty 18) around the PCs. The ring created by Surrounded follows the Dust Devil's movement. The Dust Devil is immune to attacks made from outside of the ring. A PC that wants to move into or out of the ring must succeed on a Strength Roll; a PC who fails this roll takes 4d8+8 magic damage.

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Dust Devil has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead and it loses the benefits of Nightmare Storm.

features.name: Devil's Chains
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all creatures within Close range of the Dust Devil.

features.name: Fulgrite Dust
features.text: When the Dust Devil takes damage, you can mark a Stress to make all PCs within Close range Vulnerable against the Dust Devil's next attack.

name: The Inexorable
summary: A lone gunslinger—who by all rights should be dead—reanimated by a relentless spirit of vengeance.
motive: Pursue endlessly, don't let them rest, enact vengeance

features.name: Tenacious Revenant
features.text: A PC who encounters the Inexorable becomes Pursued until the Inexorable is defeated. A Pursued PC can't take a long rest.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Inexorable can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Reap the Whirlwind
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack roll against all targets within Close range and deal 4d8+12 magic damage to each target the attack succeeds against.

features.name: Death's Chill Wind
features.text: All PCs within Far range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained until they mark 2 Stress to clear the condition.

features.name: Cast in Death's Forge
features.text: When the Inexorable fails an attack roll, their target must either mark a HP or give you a Fear.

features.name: Is There No End?
features.text: Execution Countdown (10). When the Inexorable is defeated, start a long-term Execution Countdown (10) that ticks down when a PC kills a creature. When the countdown triggers, the Inexorable reappears with all their HP and Stress cleared.
